text:
erica: heads up — ams1 control plane (console + config API) started returning 504/502 around 08:12 UTC, lots of users can't push configs or access console.

josh: seeing spike in 5xx on /v1/configs and auth failures from clients. alerts from synthetic checks.

incident-bot: created incident INC-202603-ams1 — priority P1.

mira: can we shift traffic to eu-west2 while we triage? what is current serving capacity there for GPU-heavy routes?

samir: quick summary from infra: ams1 serving nodes are healthy, but control plane (api-gw + token-service + consul) is degraded. consul raft leader flapping.

erica: real problem is rollouts are hung — PATCH /v1/rollouts/... returns 202 but never finishes. we risk half-applied configs if we force things.

deploy-bot: last rollout started at 08:05 UTC id=roll-87321 (user: platform-release).

mira: proposal: pause/hold all new rollouts for ams1 and shift production read traffic to eu-west2, push write traffic slowly.

samir: agree to pause. rollback is dangerous right now because nodes may apply half the changes. prefer pause + manual reconciliation.

erica: doing manual shift now: `rctl shift --from ams1 --to eu-west2 --weights 60:40` to start draining. will escalate if control plane doesn't recover.

josh: shift executed, cloud-lb reports drains in progress. console still 504 when trying to fetch live config for some tenants.

mira: checking token-service logs — I see a bunch of 401s and a cert-rotation error at 07:58 UTC: `cert-rotation: failed to renew cert: KMS rate limit`.

samir: that matches: token-service depends on KMS for signing during rotation; egress to KMS was being throttled by cloud provider quotas -> token validation failing -> control plane auth broken.

erica: disabling auto-cert-rotation for ams1 to stop churn while we recover.

josh: FYI shifting inference traffic to eu-west2 will bump spot/GPU spend ~+25% for the next 6 hours. tagging costs to incident. @finance FYI. :money_with_wings:

mira: created finance pager entry: inc-ams1-cost-overspill.

incident-bot: applied fallback routing rule: route hostnames ending with .ams1.redwood-inference -> eu-west2.

erica: after routing change some users regained console access but config push still errors for large rollout jobs. smaller GETs succeed.

samir: digging into consul: `consul operator raft list-peers` shows split votes (2/5). I'm forcing leader on node-3 to stop flapping.

josh: after forcing leader, control plane API responds 200 to GETs. PATCHs still hang because rollout manager holds a pending lock.

erica: I see the rollout lock in DB: `SELECT * FROM rollout_locks WHERE rollout_id='roll-87321'` — it's stuck in state=applying. I'm going to clear it manually but will snapshot state first.

mira: snapshot done. careful with manual clears.

erica: cleared lock via `UPDATE rollout_locks SET state='failed' WHERE id='roll-87321'` and then signaled rollback.

deploy-bot: resumed rollout id=roll-87321 (after manual reconciliation) -> progressing: 30% -> 60% -> 100% success. :tada:

erica: tl;dr root cause: cert rotation failed due to KMS egress throttling -> token-service auth failures -> control plane API degraded -> rollout manager locks hung. recovery path: shift traffic to eu-west2, force consul leader to stabilize raft, clear rollout lock, resume rollouts.

mira: follow-ups: add explicit alert for cert-rotation timeout + KMS error, add quota/egress monitoring for KMS endpoints, and add automated leader promotion policy for consul.

samir: i'll own the runbook updates and the consul failover automation ticket. owners: samir, erica, mira.

josh: finance/ops: monitor spend and notify if > +40% baseline.

erica: marking incident as resolved for now — will draft postmortem and link to INC-202603-ams1.

incident-bot: incident INC-202603-ams1 status -> resolved (08:30 UTC).
